name: seamwell
description: Seamwell Tailoring — single-shop e-commerce platform with AI virtual try-on (Next.js + GSAP, Node.js API, PostgreSQL).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @seamwell/api" "npm run dev -w @seamwell/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @seamwell/api && npm run build -w @seamwell/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm run start -w @seamwell/api" "npm run start -w @seamwell/web"
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:e2e:api && npm run test:e2e:web
